units.source_text: 那后面，该是目的地的海滩了吧，该有沙丘吧。

en.t: Beyond that must be the beach he was heading for, and there must be dunes there too.

units.source_text: 谁知，这村落却意外地宽阔。

en.t: But unexpectedly, the village was surprisingly spread out.

units.source_text: 仅有一小块地方露出泥地来，绝大部分都是白花花、干乎乎的沙地。

en.t: Only a small patch of earth showed through; most of it was glaring white, dry sand.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，沙地还是被辟成了花生地和山芋地，海潮的气息里，混杂着家畜的气味。

en.t: Even so, the sandy ground had been turned into peanut fields and sweet potato patches, and the smell of livestock mingled with the scent of the tide.

units.source_text: 道路用沙子和黏土固定起来，路边上，粉碎的贝壳堆积成了白色的山。

en.t: The road was packed firm with sand and clay, and along its edge crushed shells had piled up into white mounds.
